Schedule ready independent modules within three actual slots, reserve capacity for independent QA and sequence remaining module/verification roles as slots become free; retain runtime configuration.

Assign independent QA to the stable integrated interfaces, tests and untracked migration, with current meaningful checks. Preserve the plan approval but do not treat branch reports or authored tests as integrated independent verification.

Honor the explicit quota pause at the trustworthy 2.5% reading: safely stop or await both workers and preserve their changes, ownership and ledger until replenishment and authorized resume.

Obtain p3 reassessment for the API/client contract and affected QA conclusions. Retain the documentation approval with its explicit applicability confirmation; do not restart all eight reviews.

Reopen canonical I-2 using the new second-path regression, retain both prior attempts and scope the next evidenced correction under the human continuation. Do not create I-44 to reset the defect history.
Continue awaiting the working reviewer within the unchanged original 180-second deadline. A verdict-free 30-second poll supplies no evidence of failure and no reason to replace the reviewer.
Begin already authorized implementation in the Developer's exclusively owned files under the current approved plan. Initial implementation consumes no repair batch and needs no new permission.
Record completion using the current approvals, stable integrated independent QA and actual passing acceptance checks. Preserve cumulative history and stop additional review without new evidence.
